story.so_that: every refinement action begins from durable evidence and an explainable decision
story.i_want: the workflow to initialize schema-versioned run state, establish a trustworthy baseline, and select one authorized next action

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given preflight has succeeded for a run, when the workflow initializes, then a schema-versioned JSON progress record is created containing run identity, resolved repository identity, normalized inputs, authorized scope, limits, and an empty iteration history.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given preflight has succeeded for a run when the workflow initializes then a schema-versioned JSON progress record is created containing run identity resolved repository identity normalized inputs authorized scope limits and an empty iteration history

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the progress record is created, when it is inspected, then cumulative token usage and the consecutive confirmed-regression counter are initialized to zero.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the progress record is created when it is inspected then cumulative token usage and the consecutive confirmed regression counter are initialized to zero

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the run has access to secrets, credentials, or sensitive environment values, when the progress record is written, then none of those values appear in the document.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the run has access to secrets credentials or sensitive environment values when the progress record is written then none of those values appear in the document

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a worker restarts immediately after initialization, when the workflow resumes, then the same progress record is reused rather than duplicated or recreated.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a worker restarts immediately after initialization when the workflow resumes then the same progress record is reused rather than duplicated or recreated

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a valid initialized run, when the workflow establishes its baseline, then it invokes the complete evaluation suite through the deterministic evaluation command and pinned provider.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a valid initialized run when the workflow establishes its baseline then it invokes the complete evaluation suite through the deterministic evaluation command and pinned provider

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the baseline evaluation completes, when results are recorded, then passing, failing, total, percentage, and required-test-case coverage metrics, along with failures, artifact references, duration, and outcome, are stored in the progress record.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the baseline evaluation completes when results are recorded then passing failing total percentage and required test case coverage metrics along with failures artifact references duration and outcome are stored in the progress record

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the baseline evaluation cannot be executed successfully, when the workflow checks the outcome, then refinement does not begin and the failure is recorded.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the baseline evaluation cannot be executed successfully when the workflow checks the outcome then refinement does not begin and the failure is recorded

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the baseline evaluation exceeds its configured timeout, when the timeout is reached, then the attempt is recorded and handled per the configured retry policy without silently proceeding to refinement.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the baseline evaluation exceeds its configured timeout when the timeout is reached then the attempt is recorded and handled per the configured retry policy without silently proceeding to refinement

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the current progress record, latest evaluation evidence, required test cases, and remaining budgets, when a planning step runs, then it selects exactly one action from the authorized set: add or extend coverage, repair scripted checks, refine the skill, refine supporting documents, propose an evaluation expectation change, or stop.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the current progress record latest evaluation evidence required test cases and remaining budgets when a planning step runs then it selects exactly one action from the authorized set add or extend coverage repair scripted checks refine the skill refine supporting documents propose an evaluation expectation change or stop

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a planning step completes, when its result is recorded, then it includes rationale and evidence, intended files or file classes, expected effect, whether human approval is required, and a stop recommendation when applicable.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a planning step completes when its result is recorded then it includes rationale and evidence intended files or file classes expected effect whether human approval is required and a stop recommendation when applicable

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given no defensible action remains, the objective is met, or a limit prevents another safe iteration, when planning runs, then the stop action is selected and no further refinement is scheduled.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given no defensible action remains the objective is met or a limit prevents another safe iteration when planning runs then the stop action is selected and no further refinement is scheduled

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a planning result names an action outside the authorized set, when the result is validated, then the iteration is rejected and no refinement Activity is invoked for it.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a planning result names an action outside the authorized set when the result is validated then the iteration is rejected and no refinement activity is invoked for it

edge_cases.criterion: Given the preflight signal is missing or malformed, when initialization runs, then it fails fast with a clear error and no progress record is created.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the preflight signal is missing or malformed when initialization runs then it fails fast with a clear error and no progress record is created

edge_cases.criterion: Given a progress record already exists with a different schema version, when the workflow resumes, then it either migrates the record or fails with a schema version mismatch error.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a progress record already exists with a different schema version when the workflow resumes then it either migrates the record or fails with a schema version mismatch error

edge_cases.criterion: Given the run environment contains nested or obfuscated secrets, when the progress record is written, then no secret values are persisted anywhere in the document.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the run environment contains nested or obfuscated secrets when the progress record is written then no secret values are persisted anywhere in the document

edge_cases.criterion: Given the baseline evaluation command returns non-JSON or malformed output, when the workflow records results, then it records the failure and stops refinement.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the baseline evaluation command returns non JSON or malformed output when the workflow records results then it records the failure and stops refinement

edge_cases.criterion: Given the pinned provider is unreachable or returns an error, when the baseline runs, then the attempt is recorded and the retry policy is applied.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the pinned provider is unreachable or returns an error when the baseline runs then the attempt is recorded and the retry policy is applied

edge_cases.criterion: Given the baseline timeout is reached and the retry budget is exhausted, when the workflow checks the outcome, then refinement stops and the timeout is recorded.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the baseline timeout is reached and the retry budget is exhausted when the workflow checks the outcome then refinement stops and the timeout is recorded

edge_cases.criterion: Given the remaining token or iteration budget is zero, when planning runs, then the stop action is selected and no further action is scheduled.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the remaining token or iteration budget is zero when planning runs then the stop action is selected and no further action is scheduled

edge_cases.criterion: Given a planning result names an action with different casing or surrounding whitespace, when the result is validated, then it is rejected as an unauthorized action.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a planning result names an action with different casing or surrounding whitespace when the result is validated then it is rejected as an unauthorized action

edge_cases.criterion: Given the required test case mapping is missing for a selected action, when the planning result is validated, then the iteration is rejected.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the required test case mapping is missing for a selected action when the planning result is validated then the iteration is rejected

edge_cases.criterion: Given a worker resumes from a partially-written progress record, when the workflow recovers, then it reuses the existing record without duplicating state or creating a new one.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a worker resumes from a partially written progress record when the workflow recovers then it reuses the existing record without duplicating state or creating a new one

edge_cases.criterion: Given the authorized action set is empty or all actions are disallowed by scope, when planning runs, then the stop action is selected.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the authorized action set is empty or all actions are disallowed by scope when planning runs then the stop action is selected

edge_cases.criterion: Given the evaluation suite contains no test cases, when the baseline completes, then it is recorded as a failure or an explicit empty outcome and refinement does not proceed.
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the evaluation suite contains no test cases when the baseline completes then it is recorded as a failure or an explicit empty outcome and refinement does not proceed

ui: Human approval prompt when PlanningResult.requires_approval is true
database: Run identity and iteration history store

steps.description: Implement ProgressRecord data model and schema-versioned ProgressRecordStore: persist secret-free JSON under the target repository .process/edd/<run_id>/ tree keyed by run identity, and support idempotent create/resume and atomic writes
Implement ProgressRecordSerializer: allow-list only declared fields, replace environment variables and credential-bearing paths with a sentinel token, and fail on schema version mismatch

Implement InitializeRun Activity: verify preflight result and active mutation lease, derive run id from workflow run id and starting revision, locate or create the progress record, and emit InitializeRun/ResumeRun events

Implement RunBaselineEvaluation Activity: verify lease, resolve a pinned InvocationProfile, invoke the deterministic command through the Devin harness, apply in-Activity timeout and Cadence retry policy, and record each attempt in the progress record

Implement BaselineResult parser and artifact writer: parse pass/fail/coverage metrics and failures, validate expected shape, write artifact files next to the progress record, and store relative references

Implement PlanRefinementAction Activity: load the authorized action taxonomy, read the latest baseline, budgets, and progress record, select exactly one authorized action or stop, and reject any non-exact or unmapped action
Implement PlanningResult model and approval semantics: include rationale, evidence, intended files, expected effect, requires_approval flag, stop recommendation, and authorized taxonomy version

Wire the new Activities into the EDD Cadence workflow: sequence InitializeRun, RunBaselineEvaluation, and PlanRefinementAction after preflight, passing TargetRepositoryContext and emitting the instrumentation events
Render workflow progress and stop/approval prompts in the frontend, driven by PlanningResult.requires_approval without enforcement logic

unit_tests.description: ProgressRecordFactory derives run id, locates existing records, and refuses duplicate creation
ProgressRecordSerializer allow-list and redaction rules prevent secret and credential persistence
ProgressRecordStore idempotent writes and atomic updates survive simulated partial writes
BaselineResult parser validates required shape, rejects malformed output, and records empty-suite failures
Planning validator rejects non-exact action strings, missing mappings, and stop conditions
Budget and iteration counter logic triggers stop when limits are exhausted

integration_tests.description: InitializeRun creates and resumes progress records, raises on missing preflight or invalid lease, and handles schema version mismatch
RunBaselineEvaluation invokes the deterministic command, records attempts on timeout, and applies retry policy
PlanRefinementAction selects one authorized action, sets requires_approval for expectation changes, and stops when budgets or outcomes demand it
EDD workflow sequences preflight, initialization, baseline, and planning, emitting the expected instrumentation events

e2e_tests.description: Requester runs the EDD workflow through initialization, baseline, and planning and receives a durable progress record with a validated next action or stop decision

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A worker restart or retry duplicates the progress record instead of resuming the existing one
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Derive a stable run id from the workflow run id and starting revision, and use idempotent create/resume semantics keyed by that id

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Secrets, credentials, or environment values leak into the persisted progress record
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Serialize only an explicit field allow-list and redact any environment or credential-bearing paths with a sentinel token

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Resuming an older schema-versioned record corrupts state silently
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Fail-fast on schema version mismatch until a migration is explicitly designed

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Baseline command hangs, crashes, or returns malformed output and refinement proceeds
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Enforce an in-Activity timeout, use Cadence retry policy, parse and validate output, and stop refinement on empty or malformed results

risks_and_mitigations.risk: The planner emits an unauthorized or prompt-injected action name
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Validate selected action names with exact string matching and require a present required-test-case mapping

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Token or iteration budgets are exceeded because counters are not tracked
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Sum HarnessResult.usage into the progress record and increment the iteration counter before each planning step, checking limits before selecting a non-stop action

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concurrent workflows mutate the same target repository
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Verify the active mutation lease in InitializeRun, RunBaselineEvaluation, and PlanRefinementAction before any writes or external invocations

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A partially-written progress record is treated as corrupt or missing on resume
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Support atomic or idempotent write semantics and locate existing records before creation
